title: nan
key_contribution: Presents a SLAM evaluation methodology using terrestrial scanners and tests multi-LiDAR LIO (MA-LIO, SC-LIO-SAM, KISS-ICP) on a UGV in GNSS-denied infrastructure environments.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using LiDAR_SLAM to ensure precise positioning.
